title: Xanthe and the Lantern
author: P. M. Okonkwo
blurb: Coral Delacroix, a code-carrying courier on the last diplomatic mission of a doomed republic, measures the world in what can be carried when the orders come. Then the bridge — the only road out — closes for the season — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must get the truth on the record ahead of the victors' historians before the ice breaks on the river.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
